definitions: To make a person or animal clean and tidy.
To prepare someone for a particular job or position over a period of time.
To prepare the surface of a ski slope or other area.
To prepare a child or other vulnerable person for sexual abuse.
examples: She groomed her horse until its coat shone.
He was groomed for leadership from a young age.
The snow was groomed overnight for perfect skiing.
The abuser groomed the victim online.
